name: gp-producer-octroi-compliance
description: Guadeloupe internal octroi de mer for local producers, 2026. Covers who is liable (independent production activity with prior-year production turnover of at least 550,000 euros, excluding VAT and octroi), what counts as production (manufacture, transformation with a change of SH4 tariff heading, renovation, extraction, agriculture), aggregation across the five DROM, proration for a start-up year, liability from 1 January after the threshold year, identification with customs before 31 January, and quarterly electronic returns and payment by the 24th of the following month. Product rates, local exemptions and deductions are out of scope. Trigger phrases include octroi de mer interne Guadeloupe, seuil 550 000 euros, producteur octroi de mer, declaration trimestrielle octroi de mer.
